## API overview
Requests, errors and latency come from Application Insights `requests`; LLM calls from the `llm.completed`, `llm.attempt_failed` and `llm.retry` log events.

content.query: requests | summarize Requests=count(), Failed=countif(success == false) by bin(timestamp, 15m) | render timechart
content.title: Requests and failures

content.query: requests | summarize Total=count(), Failed=countif(success == false) | extend SuccessRate=round(100.0 * (Total - Failed) / Total, 2) | project Total, Failed, SuccessRate
content.title: Success rate (%)

content.query: requests | summarize Requests=count(), P95_ms=percentile(duration, 95) by name, resultCode | order by Requests desc
content.title: Requests by operation and status

content.query: requests | summarize p50=percentile(duration, 50), p95=percentile(duration, 95) by bin(timestamp, 15m) | render timechart
content.title: Latency p50 / p95 (ms)

content.query: traces | where message == "llm.completed" | extend provider=tostring(customDimensions.provider), model=tostring(customDimensions.model), prompt_version=tostring(customDimensions.prompt_version), input_tokens=toint(customDimensions.input_tokens), output_tokens=toint(customDimensions.output_tokens), latency_ms=toint(customDimensions.latency_ms) | summarize Input=sum(input_tokens), Output=sum(output_tokens) by bin(timestamp, 1h) | render columnchart
content.title: Tokens over time

content.query: traces | where message == "llm.completed" | extend provider=tostring(customDimensions.provider), model=tostring(customDimensions.model), prompt_version=tostring(customDimensions.prompt_version), input_tokens=toint(customDimensions.input_tokens), output_tokens=toint(customDimensions.output_tokens), latency_ms=toint(customDimensions.latency_ms) | summarize Calls=count(), InputTokens=sum(input_tokens), OutputTokens=sum(output_tokens), AvgLatency_ms=round(avg(latency_ms)), P95Latency_ms=percentile(latency_ms, 95) by provider, model, prompt_version | order by Calls desc
content.title: Tokens by provider, model and prompt version

content.query: traces | where message == "llm.completed" | extend provider=tostring(customDimensions.provider), model=tostring(customDimensions.model), prompt_version=tostring(customDimensions.prompt_version), input_tokens=toint(customDimensions.input_tokens), output_tokens=toint(customDimensions.output_tokens), latency_ms=toint(customDimensions.latency_ms) | summarize p50=percentile(latency_ms, 50), p95=percentile(latency_ms, 95) by bin(timestamp, 1h), provider | render timechart
content.title: LLM latency by provider (ms)

content.query: traces | where message == "llm.completed" | extend provider=tostring(customDimensions.provider), model=tostring(customDimensions.model), prompt_version=tostring(customDimensions.prompt_version), input_tokens=toint(customDimensions.input_tokens), output_tokens=toint(customDimensions.output_tokens), latency_ms=toint(customDimensions.latency_ms) | summarize Calls=count() by provider, bin(timestamp, 1h) | render columnchart
content.title: Calls by provider (fallback usage)

content.query: traces | where message == "llm.attempt_failed" | extend provider=tostring(customDimensions.provider), error_type=tostring(customDimensions.error_type) | summarize Failures=count() by provider, error_type | order by Failures desc
content.title: Failed attempts by error

content.query: traces | where message in ("llm.retry", "llm.provider_failed") | summarize Events=count() by message, bin(timestamp, 1h) | render timechart
content.title: Retries and provider failures

content.query: traces | where message == "llm.attempt_failed" | project timestamp, provider=tostring(customDimensions.provider), model=tostring(customDimensions.model), prompt_version=tostring(customDimensions.prompt_version), attempt=toint(customDimensions.attempt), latency_ms=toint(customDimensions.latency_ms), error_type=tostring(customDimensions.error_type), error=tostring(customDimensions.error), input=tostring(customDimensions.input), output=tostring(customDimensions.output) | order by timestamp desc | take 50
content.title: Latest failed attempts (input/output only when LOG_LLM_CONTENT is on)

content.query: traces | where message == "llm.completed" | extend provider=tostring(customDimensions.provider), model=tostring(customDimensions.model), prompt_version=tostring(customDimensions.prompt_version), input_tokens=toint(customDimensions.input_tokens), output_tokens=toint(customDimensions.output_tokens), latency_ms=toint(customDimensions.latency_ms) | project timestamp, provider, model, prompt_version, input_tokens, output_tokens, latency_ms, input=tostring(customDimensions.input), output=tostring(customDimensions.output) | order by timestamp desc | take 50
content.title: Latest successful calls

content.query: exceptions | summarize Count=count() by type, outerMessage | order by Count desc
content.title: Exceptions
